## E1: depth curve (descriptive)

r = |Q(U,U)|/|JU| at alpha = 1 (U = rho_l * unit direction at every valid position), D1 protocol. `level` = mean over (push, read-out) pairs of log median r; `slope` = pooled OLS slope of log r on k; `within` = slope with one intercept per push block; `power` = exponent p of r ~ k^p within push blocks. 95% CIs: paired context x direction bootstrap (B = 1000). Differences: RH/ML − FW within a model (contexts independent), P − B on one corpus (paired).
